companyFieldUpdates.name: Lineage, Inc.
companyFieldUpdates.description: Lineage, Inc. operates temperature-controlled warehouses and cold-chain logistics infrastructure for food producers, processors, retailers and distributors. The company is a publicly listed REIT with a global network of cold-storage facilities and related logistics services. Bay Grove has sponsored and controlled the platform since its 2008 formation. Stonepeak invested as a minority investor in 2018 and, as of the latest SEC disclosure, retains qualifying private BGLH-linked economic interests and contractual rights distinct from ordinary public-market shares.
